description: Neighbourhoods like one the user liked (crime, deprivation, income, price level and station access percentiles), optionally only cheaper ones (cheaper_by_percent lower £/m², crime no more than 10 points worse) and within max_budget for bedrooms: 'like this but cheaper / elsewhere'.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

bedrooms.description: Adds a ballpark price for this size.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

cheaper.description: Only areas with a £/m² price level at least cheaper_by_percent lower, and crime no more than 10 percentile points worse.
cheaper.title: Cheaper

cheaper_by_percent.description: With cheaper: how much lower the £/m² level is.
cheaper_by_percent.title: Cheaper By Percent

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

max_budget.description: With bedrooms or property_type: only areas whose price (the type's figure, else the ballpark) is within it.
max_budget.title: Max Budget

property_type.description: The home type: estimatedPrice and the max_budget filter read the type's typical price, all sizes (the figure find_areas and get_area_overview quote for it).
property_type.title: Property Type

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried (none: the last answer). Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.

name: find_similar_areas
title: Find similar areas
